headline: A federal law that names a Lompoc, California post office building after Federal Correctional Officer Scott J. Williams.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 801 West Ocean Avenue in Lompoc, California. The building will be called the "Federal Correctional Officer Scott J. Williams Memorial Post Office Building." It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or fees.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
